description:
Wave-2 duplicate-check triage (2026-03-12) identifies 8 consolidation-worthy
groups across SQL platform adapters and the primitives layer. These are
parallel implementations where platforms with shared heritage or identical
dispatch patterns can share a base implementation.

Targets (report rank → dup lines):

G8 (60 dup lines): add_cli_arguments in postgresql.py:67 and
    timescaledb.py:77. TimescaleDB is a PostgreSQL extension; both
    platforms share identical connection arguments (host, port, database,
    username, password, schema, work_mem, maintenance_work_mem).
    Only argument prefix (--postgres-* vs --timescale-*) and
    TimescaleDB-specific additions (chunk_interval, compression) differ.

G9 (60 dup lines): _validate_catalog_exists in presto.py:401 and
    trino.py:515. Byte-for-byte identical except for error message
    strings ("Presto" vs "Trino"). Textbook mixin candidate.

G11 (57 dup lines): get_queries in amplab/benchmark.py:103,
    clickbench/benchmark.py:79, h2odb/benchmark.py:103,
    ssb/benchmark.py:109. All follow identical pattern: fetch queries
    from query_manager → optionally translate dialect → return dict.

G12 (57 dup lines): _generate_catalog_returns_from_sale and
    _generate_web_returns_from_sale in tpcds/maintenance_operations.py
    :985 and :1043. Identical structure (11 mapped fields + 3
    random/calculated), differing only by tuple field names and
    column prefixes (CR_* vs WR_*).

G13 (57 dup lines): execute_query in doris.py:819 and
    postgresql.py:548. Virtually identical: execute via cursor →
    measure time → validate row count → build result with
    _build_query_result_with_validation.

G18 (54 dup lines): get_dataframe_metadata_manager,
    get_dataframe_transaction_manager, get_dataframe_write_manager
    in metadata_primitives/dataframe_operations.py:1775,
    transaction_primitives/dataframe_operations.py:1202,
    write_primitives/dataframe_operations.py:874. Identical factory
    dispatch: normalize platform_name → check df_platforms tuple →
    instantiate manager class.

G24 (51 dup lines): get_operation/get_query_entry in
    ai_primitives/queries.py:47, metadata_primitives/queries.py:46,
    transaction_primitives/operations.py:54,
    write_primitives/operations.py:54. Identical lookup pattern:
    try entries[id] → except KeyError → raise ValueError with
    available keys.

G28 (50 dup lines): aggregation_distinct_groupby_pandas_impl,
    aggregation_groupby_large_pandas_impl,
    aggregation_groupby_small_pandas_impl in
    read_primitives/dataframe_queries.py (lines 1363-2661).
    6 instances of identical groupby→agg→sort pattern varying only
    in column names and cardinality.

anti_patterns.dont: create a PostgreSQL base class that TimescaleDB inherits for ALL methods
anti_patterns.why: only share the CLI argument helper, not the full adapter

anti_patterns.dont: create an abstract base for all SQL platforms' execute_query
anti_patterns.why: only consolidate the specific Doris/PostgreSQL pair that is byte-for-byte identical

anti_patterns.dont: merge Presto and Trino into a single adapter
anti_patterns.why: only share the catalog validation utility

anti_patterns.dont: use *args/**kwargs in the returns generation helper
anti_patterns.why: use explicit field_mapping and channel_fields parameters for type safety

preserves.behavior: Manager factory dispatch maps identical platform names to identical manager classes
Presto/Trino catalog validation error messages contain platform-specific name
TPC-DS returns generation: catalog returns use CR_* columns, web returns use WR_* columns
TimescaleDB CLI args include all PostgreSQL-compatible params plus chunk_interval and compression
execute_query return format identical for Doris and PostgreSQL (timing, validation, error dict)
get_entry_by_id raises ValueError with sorted available keys in error message
